answer: Problem: sybil mills splice cheap aliases onto one work thread and cash many seats from one desk. Mechanism: a grader winds a spiral of five timed proofs, each hashed to a different parent block and sealed in a hollow canister only that key can open, 13 minutes per turn. Cost: lock 11.6 stake-units for 38 hours; each extra name needs its own canister and spiral. Verification: auditors unwind the spiral from public receipts and slash fingerprints reused under two names. Failure: two identities sharing one hollow canister, or a spiral that repeats a parent hash, voids the thread claim.
